name: relay-hls
_comment: Relay (server/relay.mjs) origin for internet viewing: --host <relay host> (https://<host>; for a local relay pass --base http://127.0.0.1:<port> and --relay-health http://127.0.0.1:<port>/healthz). Every viewer joins a viewer session first (POST /<path>/session -> {sid, heartbeatMs}; 503 + Retry-After at the relay's viewer cap is waited out, at most 6 times), heartbeats with PUT /<path>/session/<sid> every heartbeatMs and leaves with DELETE, then plays live.m3u8 like the page (parts + blocking reloads, video + AAC). Target statistics: the relay's /healthz (hlsSessions = target session count, hlsViewers); the relay has no per-path ingest counter, so the full-rate reference is live.m3u8 AVERAGE-BANDWIDTH (the relay's own measured average) unless --reference-kbps source=<kbit/s> is given. The 429/503 share stop rule covers session, playlist and media answers. Relay egress may be metered: the 20 GB cap stops the run before a stage that would pass it (raise it deliberately with --max-traffic-gb). Requests through a CDN in front of the relay are not separated from the origin here; a run from one generator PC is that PC's capacity, not 1,000 internet viewers. One headless Edge page with the relay's viewer page runs after the holds of stages 1 and 10.
